scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: If you freeze a powerful attack in a fighting game, you may see a dramatically twisted waist or an arm stretched unusually far.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: The movement felt powerful in motion, yet the body can look strange in a single frame.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: If we restore those poses to a more normal shape, will the attack improve too?

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Today, we will examine how movement reads on screen, the limits of a character’s skeleton, and, finally, moving slightly past a target and back.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: An attack is a connected movement of the feet, hips, torso, shoulders, and hand, not just the hand by itself.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: A middle pose can look excessive alone yet reveal the direction of force when connected to the poses before and after it.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: At gameplay size, small differences that were clear up close can disappear.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Keep the camera and duration fixed, then enlarge the shoulder and torso movement that viewers need to read.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Judge whether the continuous action communicates direction and force, rather than whether each isolated frame looks restrained.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: A pose may be deliberately designed to convey power. If we change it based only on its frozen appearance, we can change the impression of the movement.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: During a broad swing of the arm, the torso must turn with it for the hand to look forceful.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: With the torso held still, even an arm movement in the same direction can feel weak.

lines: The height of her hand matters, but so does how low she was just before takeoff.

lines: That difference matters more when the character looks small.

lines: But when the camera moves farther away, that difference shrinks to a few tiny dots.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Watch the Dynamo Roller being raised in Splatoon 3. The wide roller stands out above the small character. Now our demonstration compares the same motion at a large and a small screen size.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Now, we will fix the small view’s camera and playback timing and increase only the shoulder and waist movement.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: This is exaggeration of movement.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: It brings out the differences that make an attack readable so that the screen size does not hide them.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: For a small character’s attack, first consider whether insufficient movement is draining its power, rather than excessive exaggeration.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Even if a movement initially seems sufficient, push it one step further and compare.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Keep the movement and camera the same and view it at the actual gameplay size. It becomes easier to judge how well its power comes across.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Even if you want to make the movement larger, the character’s controls may not allow it.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Inside a character are reference points linked like bones. Moving them changes the surface of the body.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Together, this skeleton and its controls are called a rig.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Think about raising an arm.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: In a real person, more than the arm rotates: the shoulder’s position and the torso also change.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Changing direction around the point where a joint attaches is rotation; moving that point itself is translation.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: If a rig lets you change only the arm’s angle, while the shoulder’s attachment to the torso stays fixed, creating the pose you want can be difficult.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: On screen, we compare a rig with fixed shoulder positions with one whose shoulders can move forward and backward.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Even with the same target for the hand, the shape of the shoulder and chest changes.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Controls and tools that also handle shoulder translation expand the range of movements you can express.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Identify which parts must rotate or move for the intended action, and use the appropriate controls.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Even with more freedom to move the body, making each intermediate pose look attractive is not enough.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: As the feet push against the ground and the pelvis turns, with the shoulders and arms following, different directions of motion can briefly overlap.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: The waist and legs may look mismatched in that instant, but in motion, that pose may help create a powerful turn.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: So first, watch the entire movement at its actual speed.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Check where the force appears to travel, then pause at the moments you need to inspect.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: If you remove every twist based only on paused poses, you can also lose the flow of the attack.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Fix problems with the joints or surface, while preserving the role that each pose plays within the movement.

lines: This time, watch Kula on the right.

lines: She spins in the air, then slides along the ground.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Slow it down: the body turns after the arm reaches up, and one leg extends far to the side.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: As soon as she lands, her foot shoots out near the floor.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: An upright pose alone wouldn't tell you this, but the changes in height and direction carry the spin through.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: How a pose is reached also affects the sense of power.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Moving an object forward and stopping exactly on target looks neat.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Moving a little farther and then settling into place can feel like the object is absorbing its momentum.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: This movement slightly beyond the target is called overshoot.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: In our example, the starting point on the floor is zero centimeters, and we mark the target one hundred centimeters ahead.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: We compare stopping directly at one hundred centimeters with moving to one hundred ten centimeters and returning to one hundred, over the same duration.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: The second goes ten centimeters past the target and returns.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: We chose these distances for this comparison; you can adjust them to suit the movement.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: The same idea applies not only to position, but also to body size or the shape of extending spikes.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Let the spikes reach their largest spread, then shrink a little as they settle.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Even a brief change from the largest image to a slightly smaller one in the very next frame can preserve the forceful impression of popping outward.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Exaggerating motion helps communicate the intended action clearly at the actual screen size and playback speed.

scenes.title: Exaggeration (동작의 과장)
lines: Choose what moves more and when it overshoots and returns, and even a small character can look powerful.
